name: Golden baseline
description: Reference, not a model. For each problem, language, and metric, the best correct solution that the campaign LLMs produced, frozen on 10 Oct 2026. Copied from stored results: nothing was generated or measured again. Listed on the leaderboards, never ranked.

name: Direct (no agent)
description: The model was prompted once with no agentic loop — the baseline producer. This is the legacy default: every submission that predates the agent abstraction, and every new submission that names no agent, is attributed to it.
